Acceptance criterion: Every screen has route, persona, purpose, hierarchy, fields, actions, states and acceptance criteria
No screen trusts client weddingId; tenant scope comes from authenticated session
Co-owner, Treasurer, organiser and guest views show only authorised information/actions
Two distinct co-owner accounts; initiator counts as first; duplicate identity blocked
ACTIVE/SUSPENDED membership elsewhere returns conflict without consuming invitation
Guests see published snapshot only; stale proposal cannot publish
Function or General scope, one responsible owner, mandatory checklist, no dependency cycles
One response per guest per function; partial household; extra guest request does not create guest
Only co-owners/Treasurer; Treasurer-created/beneficiary expense requires co-owner dual approval
Amounts persisted in integer paise; formatting and rounding tested
Razorpay UPI only; verify signature/webhook; idempotency; pending state until confirmed
Brevo OTP expiry, attempt limit, resend cooldown, anti-enumeration, secret handling
JPG/PNG, 5 MB max, signature/MIME validation, dimension limit, EXIF GPS stripped
Guest upload only to invited function; guest views approved photos only; private signed URLs
Desktop/tablet/mobile at target breakpoints; no core horizontal overflow
WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, keyboard, focus, labels, screen reader, zoom/reflow
Retry, offline, stale/conflict, provider outage, partial failure and duplicate submission handled
Append-only audit; export dual co-owner; no secrets/OTP/payment secrets in logs
Legal/operational policy signed; tombstone and restore suppression tested; backup expiry validated
Representative users complete top workflows without facilitator rescue
Approved reference states captured and compared at each viewport
